senses.gloss: उद्गन्धि उद्-गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, fragrant.

उद्गम् उद्-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्,
to go up, rise, ascend; to shoot up; to go out, come
from, break out, depart; to spread.

उद्-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone up, risen, ascended;
[]
gone, departed; proceeded forth or from; vomited,
cast up; (आ), f. a stanza of four lines, with ten sylla-
bles in the first three and thirteen in the last.
—उद्-
गत-शृङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, (a calf) whose horns are
just appearing.
—उद्गतासु (˚त-असु), उस्, उस्, उ, de-
ceased, dead.

उद्-गति, इस्, f. going up, rising, ascent; coming
forth; bringing up, vomiting.

उद्-गम, अस्, m. going up, rising, ascending,
elevation (as of a mountain); rising (of the stars);
going out or away; coming forth, becoming visible,
production, creation; shoot (of a plant); bringing
up, vomiting.

उद्-गमन, अम्, n. rising, ascending; coming
forth, becoming visible.

उद्-गमनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone up or ascended;
(अम्), n. a pair of bleached cloths or sheets.

उद्गल् उद्-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, -लितुम्, to
trickle out, ooze out; issue in drops.

उद्गा उद्-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to rise
(as the sun &c.); to come forward, to begin.
उद्गातृ उद्-गातृ, &c. See उद्-गै below.
उद्गार उद्-गार, &c. See उद्-गॄ below.

उद्-गार, अस्, m. spitting out, ejecting anything
from the mouth, vomiting; belching, eructation; re-
lating repeatedly; spittle, saliva; speaking in the
throat, sound, roaring, hissing.

उद्-गार; add — swelling, heaving [cf. सागरोद्-
गार].

उद्गाह् उद्-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम्
or -गाढुम्, to emerge.

उद्-गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, excessive, violent, much;
(अम्), ind. excessively, much.

उद्गुर् उद्-गुर्, cl. 6. A. -गुरते, -रितुम्, to
raise the voice in a threatening manner.

उद्-गूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, lifted, held up;
erected, excited.

उद्गुह् उद्-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते, -गूहि-
तुम् or -गोढुम्, to pierce through and through, to
twist through.

उद्गॄ उद्-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति or -गिलति, -गरि-
तुम् or -लितुम्, or -गरीतुम् or -लीतुम्, to eject (from
the mouth), spit out, vomit out or up, belch out, pour
out, discharge; breathe out; to rise from: Caus. P.
-गिरयति, -यितुम्, to cause to pour forth, to raise (a
sound), to cause to utter sounds.
उद्-गारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, ejecting, spitting, vomiting.

उद्-गिरण, अम्, n. vomiting; ejecting anything
(as saliva &c.) from the mouth, slavering.

उद्-गीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, vomited forth, ejected, cast
forth, breathed out, exhaled, disdained.

उद्गै उद्-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to be-
gin to sing; to sing or chant (applied especially to
the singing or chanting of the Sāma-veda, from which
one order of priests take the name of Udgātṛ); to
announce, to celebrate in song; to sing before any
one (with acc.); to fill with song.
उद्गातु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to sing.

उद्-गाथा, f. a variety of the Āryā measure, the
same as the Gīti, a stanza of four half-lines, contain-
ing alternately twelve and eighteen instants.

उद्-गीति, इस्, f. singing; chanting of the Sāma-
veda; a variety of the Āryā metre, a verse of four
half-lines, containing twelve, fifteen, twelve, eighteen
instants.

उद्-गीथ, अस्, m. chanting of the Sāma-veda, the
office of the Udgātṛ; the second part of the Sāma-
veda; N. of a son of Bhava; N. of a commentator
of Vedic texts; designation of ॐ or the triliteral
name of God.

उद्ग्रन्थ् उद्-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. 1. P. A. -ग्रथ्नाति,
नीते, or -ग्रन्थति, -ते, -ग्रन्थितुम्, to bind up,
tie into bundles; to tie up, truss; to fasten, wind; to
unbind, loosen.

उद्-ग्रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, interlaced; unbound,
loosened.
उद्-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. a section, chapter.
उद्-ग्रन्थि, इस्, इस्, इ, untied, free from worldly ties.

उद्ग्रह् उद्-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति or
Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to take or lift up;
to set up, erect, elevate; to take out, draw out, take
away; to take away from, to preserve; to cease,
especially to cease to rain; to break off, discontinue
(speaking); A. to raise one's self: Caus. -ग्राहयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to take up or out, to cause to pay;
to extol, extol with praise.

उद्-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, taken up, turned up, up-
raised.
उद्-ग्रभण, अम्, n., Ved. taking up, raising.

उद्-ग्रह, अस्, m. taking up; any object that may
be accomplished by religious or other acts.

उद्-ग्राह, अस्, m. taking up or away; (in the Prā-
tiśākhyas) the rule of Sandhi which causes the change
of the terminations अः, ए, and ओ, to अ before a follow-
ing vowel; replying in argument; objection.
—उद्-
ग्राह-पदवृत्ति, इस्, f. the Sandhi called Udgrāha
before a long vowel.
—उद्ग्राह-वत्, ind. (in the
Prātiśākhyas) ‘like the Udgrāha,’ a term applied to
that kind of Sandhi by which final अ and आ appear as
अम्म् before ऋ.

उद्-ग्रहण, अम्, n. taking up, lifting up, taking
away or out.
उद्-ग्राभ, अस्, m., Ved. raising, elevating.
उद्ग्राहणिका, f. replying in argument.

उद्-ग्राहित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken away, lifted up; de-
posited, delivered; seized; bound, tied; excellent,
exalted; recalled, remembered.

उद्ग्रीव उद्-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, or उद्-ग्रीविन्, ई,
इणी, इ, one who lifts up or raises the neck (in trying
to see anything).
